comments.author: carol
comments.body:
**Should fix** — product timestamps written without a timezone

`write_daily` formats `day_start` with `strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')`. The resulting string has no offset, so a consumer cannot tell whether it is UTC or local time. `datetime.now()` on line 19 is also naive.

Suggested change: use `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` and format with `isoformat()`.

comments.author: erin
comments.body: +00:00 works but it isn't what the rest of the files use. Every timestamp we write is UTC and ends in `Z`, e.g. `2026-10-03T00:00:00Z`. Downstream parsers split on that. Use `.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')` on an aware UTC datetime here.
